notes.title: EA SPORTS FC™ 26 | FC 26 PC Deep Dive
notes.content:
Hey everyone! In the PC Deep Dive Pitch Notes we’re diving into all the ways we’ve improved the PC experience for EA SPORTS FC 26. Thanks to your feedback, we’ve made foundational changes that give you more control, smoother performance, and clearer settings across the board.

Here’s what we’ll cover:

[list]
[*] Controller Support Enhancements
[*] Expanded Display Settings
[*] Improved Graphics Settings Usability
[*] Display Settings Guide
[*] Graphics Settings Guide
[*] PC Requirements
[*] EA Javelin Anticheat
[/list]
[h2]Controller Support Enhancements[/h2]

We know many of you play on PC with controllers, and this year we’ve added more immersive support.

[list]
[*] DualShock®4 Support: Full vibration support when playing on PC with a USB connection.
[*] DualSense™ Controller Support: Includes haptics and adaptive triggers for a more immersive experience with a USB connection (basic vibration support over Bluetooth).
[/list]
[h2]Expanded Display Settings[/h2]

We’ve added more flexibility so you can fine tune FC 26 to match your setup and preferences.

[list]
[*] Active Monitor Selection: Choose which monitor you want to run the game on directly from in-game settings.
[*] Aspect Ratio Filter: Quickly find supported resolutions based on your display’s aspect ratio.
[*] More Frame Rate Limit Options: Frame rate limits now extend beyond 120 FPS, with support for 144, 165, and 240 FPS.
[*] More VSync Options: Sync your frame rate to a fraction of your monitor’s refresh rate (½, ⅓, ¼).
[*] Render Scale: Adjust resolution relative to your render setting, especially useful for windowed or borderless modes.
[*] Dynamic Resolution FPS Target: Set a performance target to trigger dynamic resolution scaling automatically.
[/list]
[h2]Improved Graphics Settings Usability[/h2]

We’ve worked to make PC graphics settings easier to understand and quicker to configure.

[list]
[*] Informative Settings Descriptions: Every graphics setting now includes descriptions and impact details on CPU, GPU, and VRAM usage.
[*] Graphics Quality Presets: Switch between predefined options like Low, Medium, High, Ultra, and Auto to adjust quality settings (restart required to take effect).
[/list]
[h2]Display Settings Guide[/h2]

Here’s a breakdown of key display settings, grouped for easier navigation.

[h3]Screen Setup[/h3]
[list]
[*] Active Monitor (NEW): Choose which monitor displays the game in Borderless or Full Screen.
[*] Display Mode:
Borderless: Fills your screen without borders (cannot be resized).
Fullscreen: Uses your entire screen.
Windowed: Runs in a resizable, movable window.
[*] Aspect Ratio (NEW): Filters resolutions by chosen aspect ratio (Fullscreen only).
[*] Screen Resolution: Sets display resolution. Higher = sharper image, but lower performance (Fullscreen only). Borderless uses OS resolution. Tip: use Render Scale to adjust in Borderless.
[/list]
[h3]Frame Rate & Refresh[/h3]
[list]
[*] Refresh Rate: Controls how often your monitor refreshes (Fullscreen only).
[*] Frame Rate Limit: Caps FPS when VSync is off.
[*] VSync: Syncs FPS to your monitor to prevent tearing.
Off: No sync.
On: Matches refresh rate.
50%, 33%, 25%: Syncs FPS to a fraction of refresh rate.
[Example: On a 240Hz monitor → 120 FPS (50%), 80 FPS (33%), 60 FPS (25%).
[*] Cutscene Performance: Controls FPS in cutscenes, menus, replays, and set-piece cameras.
Half Frame Rate: 50% of refresh rate or frame limit.
Full Frame Rate: Matches your frame rate limit. Disabled when VSync is fractional.
[/list]
[h3]Scaling Tools[/h3]
[list]
[*] Render Scale (NEW): Adjusts render resolution relative to screen resolution.
Below 100% = better performance, less sharp
Above 100% = sharper visuals, heavier GPU load.
[*] Dynamic Resolution Scaling (DRS): Lowers resolution dynamically to maintain FPS (GPU-limited only).
[*] Dynamic Resolution FPS Target: Set the FPS you want DRS to maintain.
Example: Target 90 FPS → resolution scales in real time to stay near 90 FPS.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702522/8fbe8fbf9642ee1068364628ac5803c6305b3930.png[/img]

[h2]Graphics Settings Guide[/h2]

The game will need to be restarted for changes to graphics settings to take effect.

[h3]Graphics Presets (NEW)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Auto: Optimized for your hardware.
[*] Low: Best for minimum-spec PCs.
[*] Medium: Balanced visuals and performance.
[*] High: Improved fidelity for stronger PCs.
[*] Ultra: Maximum detail for top-tier hardware.
[/list]
[h3]Fidelity Settings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rendering Quality: Controls detail and lighting on players, stadiums, and objects.
CPU: Heavy use
GPU: Heavy use
VRAM: Heavy use
[*] Strand Based Hair: Simulates individual strands of hair.
CPU: Moderate use
GPU: Heavy use
VRAM: Low use
[*] Cloth Quality: Determines jersey look and physics.
CPU: Heavy use
GPU: Moderate use
VRAM: Low use
[*] Ambient Occlusion Quality: Adds depth and realism with shading.
CPU: Heavy use
GPU: Heavy use
VRAM: Moderate use

[h3]Stadium Settings[/h3]

[*] Grass Quality: Controls pitch detail.
CPU: Low use
GPU: Moderate use
VRAM: Low use
[*] Crowd Quality: Controls crowd detail and animation.
CPU: Moderate use
GPU: Moderate use
VRAM: Moderate use

[h3]Visual Extras[/h3]

[*] Motion Blur: Slight blur on fast-moving objects.
CPU: Low use
GPU: Low use
VRAM: Low use

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702522/cd42f23b2287014eec45a03a9067bce81bd63701.png[/img]

[h2]PC Requirements[/h2]
Here are the minimum and recommended PC specifications for FC 26 so you can prepare your setup accordingly:


[*] Minimum (720p, 60 FPS gameplay, Low preset)
OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit, latest update)
CPU: Intel Core i5-6600k or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
Memory: 8 GB RAM
GPU: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD RX 570 (4 GB VRAM)
Storage: 100 GB
DirectX: Version 12
Network: Broadband Internet connection

[*] Recommended (1080p, 60 FPS gameplay, Medium preset)
OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit, latest update)
CPU: Intel Core i7-6700 or AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
Memory: 12 GB RAM
GPU: NVIDIA GTX 1660 or AMD RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM)
Storage: 100 GB
DirectX: Version 12
Network: Broadband Internet connection

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702522/fe739d8887d0d1922b95d4bc0e86670093b1a2db.jpg[/img]

[h2]EA Javelin Anticheat[/h2]

You’ve told us how important it is to tackle cheating on PC, and it remains one of our top priorities as we keep developing and refining solutions to protect fair play.

For FC 26 on PC, we’re continuing to protect fair play with EA Javelin Anticheat.

[h3]What EA Javelin Anticheat Does[/h3]
EA Javelin Anticheat aims to prevent, identify, and address bad experiences wherever possible. It’s active in FC 26 from day one and is always working in the background when you’re playing.

[h3]What’s New for FC 26[/h3]

[*] Refined Detection Methods: EA Javelin Anticheat now includes new classes of detections that make it better at spotting unfair play.
[*] Improved Fair Play Controls: FC 26 has more controls to verify that EA Javelin Anticheat is running and hasn’t been tampered with whenever you play, preventing various forms of unfair play.

[h3]Kernel-Level Protection[/h3]

Some cheats run at the deepest level of a computer’s operating system, which can make them almost invisible to traditional detection methods. EA Javelin Anticheat runs at the kernel level so it can spot and block those cheats effectively. For FC players, this means:

[*] EA Javelin Anticheat only runs when EA SPORTS FC 26 is active on your PC.
[*] If you uninstall FC 26 (and any other EA games that use EA Javelin Anticheat), the driver also uninstalls.

[h2]Share Your Feedback[/h2]

We’re committed to making sure the PC experience feels just as smooth, fair and optimized as any other platform. Your feedback is essential, so please use the [url=https://www.ea.com/nl/games/ea-sports-fc/fc-26/features/feedback]FC Feedback Hub[/url] and join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/easportsfc]EA SPORTS FC Discord [/url]to provide feedback directly for our teams.

notes.title: EA SPORTS FC™ 25 | Season Finale Update
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone, the Season Finale Update (Title Update #15) is releasing soon for EA SPORTS FC 25. With this update we’re making three adjustments to game balance based on your feedback, and some updates to Ultimate Team and Career Mode. Here’s what you can expect:[/p][list][*][p]Moderately increased accuracy of Ground Passes for players with high Passing related Attributes.[/p][/*][*][p]Significantly reduced effectiveness of goalkeepers rushing out with the Rush Out PlayStyle, and slightly reduced that effectiveness for Rush Out PlayStyle+ players.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased accuracy of contested and uncontested headers.[/p][/*][*][p]A new season and Premium Pass in Ultimate Team.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the maximum number of PlayStyles+ UT Player Items can have up to five.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Player Career ICON selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Refreshed Career Mode UI for Fixtures and Results.[/p][/*][*][p]Refreshed the main menu with a festive celebration theme.[/p][/*][/list][p]One of our main goals with this update is to provide fair and fun gameplay outcomes based on your feedback, but without drastically changing how the game is being played.[/p][p][/p][p]Let’s dig into it some more.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Gameplay Updates[/b][/h2][h3][b]Improving Ground Passes For Skilled Passers[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]In the Season Finale Update, we’ve made the following passing change based on your feedback:[/p][list][*][p]Moderately increased Ground Pass accuracy for players with high Passing related Attributes.[/p][list][*][p]This change does not impact Driven Ground Passes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]With this change we’re looking to reduce the gap between players who can be excellent passers thanks to their high Passing related Attributes, and players who have passing related PlayStyles. We want both types of players to be able to perform great passes.[/p][p]Here’s how a Ground Pass could have looked before this update, with a high Passing Attribute player.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/1e290bdf8247ae339731a47833adba348bee87d1.png"][/img][/p][p]Now let’s take a look at how this pass can play out after the update. Note the increase in accuracy.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/ce6983c68494c26d8819e0ba1a29688501d05bcf.png"][/img][/p][p]Of course, passing is still impacted by everything you’d expect including clean inputs and defensive pressure on the passer.[/p][p]We want passing to feel authentic in FC 25, and we want players who pass the ball well in real life to pass it well in our game too.[/p][h3][b]Reduced GK Rush Out PlayStyle Effectiveness[/b][/h3][p]We’ve tweaked goalkeepers in the Season Finale Update based on your feedback:[/p][list][*][p]Slightly reduced the rate of acceleration for goalkeepers with the Rush Out PlayStyle+.[/p][/*][*][p]Significantly reduced the rate of acceleration for goalkeepers with the Rush Out PlayStyle.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ve seen and heard from you that the keepers with the Rush Out PlayStyle+ were overly effective at closing down attackers. Here’s how that could have looked before this update.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="_vy3YGh7mrs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Now, here’s how that situation can play out. Note that the goalkeeper isn’t closing down the space as quickly as before.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Nmw6G5_bkHo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Naturally we don’t want to take away the ability of goalkeepers to rush incoming attackers, but with this change our goal is to create more balanced one on one situations and encourage a wider variety of defensive strategies.[/p][h3][b]Improving Header Accuracy[/b][/h3][p]We’ve seen your feedback about wanting headers to be a more viable attacking option, so we made the following change:[/p][list][*][p]Slightly increased accuracy of headers performed by the shooting input.[/p][/*][/list][p]While nobody wants every single header to be a goal, we’ve seen the need for increasing the effectiveness of headers in FC 25. Here’s how a header could have looked before the Season Finale Update.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="BK9RBDsvlMw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Now let’s take a look at a more accurate header that you can perform after this update.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="uwJjZGFbW-o;full"][/previewyoutube][h2][b]Football Ultimate Team Updates[/b][/h2][h3][b]Season 8 And A New Premium Pass[/b][/h3][p]It’s almost time for Season 8 in FUT, and it’ll be kicking off on [b]Thursday, June 5th.[/b] The new season also brings a brand new Premium Pass to FC 25, and we’ve listed everything you can expect from it below. [/p][p]We have updated our Playstyle+ Evolution Consumables requirements for Season 8! [/p][list][*][p]In the Standard Ladder, the requirements for the Playstyle+ Evolutions will be: Max 95 OVR, Max 9 Playstyles, Max 3 Playstyle+.[/p][/*][*][p]In the Premium Pass, the requirements for the Playstyle+ Evolutions will be: Max 96 OVR, Max 9 Playstyles, Max 3 Playstyle+.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you want to know about the Season Pass and how it works in-game, be sure to check out our [url="https://www.ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/fc-25/news/pitch-notes-fc25-premium-pass"][u]Pitch Notes on it,[/u][/url] complete with an FAQ section.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/c6e7c53f3cff14306780f67b851faea0d6dbc44b.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Increased Maximum Amount Of PlayStyle+ Assignments[/b][/h3][p]With the Season Finale Update, Player Items can now have up to five PlayStyle+ in Ultimate Team.[/p][p]We’re making this update so we can provide you with a larger variety of Player Items going forward. You may notice that you can now gain up to a maximum of five new PlayStyle+ as rewards through Evolutions, or certain Player Items show more PlayStyle+ UI indicators.[/p][p]Of course this doesn’t mean that every Player Item with multiple PlayStyles+ will have five of them, it just means that five is the new max.[/p][h2][b]Career Mode, Main Menu, And More[/b][/h2][p]As part of the Season Finale Update, we’re adding the final set of Live Start Points for FC 25, plus you can now play as the following ICONs in Player Career:[/p][list][*][p]Birgit Prinz[/p][/*][*][p]George Best[/p][/*][*][p]Johan Cruyff[/p][/*][*][p]Garrincha[/p][/*][/list][p]In Manager Career, you will now be able to play 5v5 Youth Tournament Matches in co-op, up to four players, via the addition of the Side Select functionality.[/p][p]We’ve also tweaked how match results around your club are covered in your Career Mode social media feeds, with a new and improved logic allowing you to see a refreshed Fixtures & Results UI, like the one below.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/1ba74e039448efa8955ef46b033320b7755d1ea4.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Feedback[/b][/h2][p]We’re excited to hear what you think about these changes. You can share your feedback directly in the Season Finale Update thread in our #game-feedback Discord channel [u][url="https://discord.com/channels/1164979454557290546/1364363630073745508"]here[/url][/u], and on the [u][url="https://go.ea.com/FC25PF"]Player Feedback Portal[/url][/u].[/p][p]Thanks for stopping by.[/p][p]– The EA SPORTS FC Team[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]EA SPORTS FC™ 25 is available now for PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, PC, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch™, as well as through [u][url="https://www.ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/ea-play"]EA Play[/url][/u].[/p][p]Thanks to those who’ve provided and continue to provide feedback. Throughout the course of the EA SPORTS FC 25 season, we'll provide you with more information and updates if and when they become available. Be sure to follow [u][url="https://twitter.com/EASFCDirect"]@‌EASFCDIRECT[/url][/u] on X and to check out the [u][url="https://trello.com/b/keigLn6R/ea-sports-fifa-tracker"]EA SPORTS FC Tracker[/url][/u] for the latest news and updates. Stay in the conversation on all things EA SPORTS FC™ by joining our official [u][url="http://discord.gg/easportsfc"]Discord[/url][/u], following us on our official [u][url="https://twitter.com/EASPORTSFC"]X[/url][/u],[u][url="https://www.instagram.com/easportsfc/"] Instagram[/url][/u], and [u][url="https://www.youtube.com/@easportsfc"]YouTube[/url][/u], and participating in the [u][url="https://answers.ea.com/t5/EA-SPORTS-FC-24/ct-p/fc-24-en"]official EA SPORTS FC Forums[/url][/u].[/p]

notes.title: TITLE UPDATE #10
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/4aa33051900b1f7203deba0e101bb0bb3aaeb88c.png[/img]

We are excited to release the Legends Return Update (TU #10) in the coming days, and it's going to bring a new shooting PlayStyle, new Player Items and ICONs, and much more. You can expect to see:

[list]
[*] A new Low Driven Shot PlayStyle and PlayStyle+.
[*] Reduced Precision Lob Pass accuracy.
[*] The return of the fabled Roma Trio to Football Ultimate Team and the addition of Franz Beckenbauer as an ICON.
[*] New Super Sub Player Items that receive full Chemistry when coming into a match.
[*] The return of the Classic XI to Kick Off and Online Friendlies, and the addition of Canada's Women's National Team.
[*] Increased Clubs level cap by 20 and added new Facilities.
[*] The new Target Live UT Friendly inspired by the Low Drive Shot PlayStyle.
[*] Updated Career Mode UI and Player Career ICON selection.
[*] Updated visual flair with refreshed main menu vibes, set piece animations, and new SuperFans in pre-match scenes.
[/list]
This update does not contain any major balance changes to the game, it has a few smaller tweaks based on your feedback alongside a few issues addressed that we've highlighted below.

Let's jump into it.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[h3]The New Low Driven Shot PlayStyle & PlayStyle+[/h3]

We have seen your feedback around shooting and wanting to have more options on that front, and we are excited to bring the new Low Driven Shot PlayStyle in the Legends Return Update. Our intent here is to enable you to more consistently perform precise shots taken with a short press of the shooting input, often referred to as low driven shots. The Low Driven PlayStyle has the following effects:
[list]
[*] Significantly increased shot accuracy.
[*] Moderately increased ball travel speed.
[*] Moderately increased how quickly players can perform the requested shot.
[/list]
Note that the Low Driven Shot PlayStyle+ has the same effects as above, but they are tuned to be more effective.

Here's how this shot type can look with no PlayStyles in effect.

[previewyoutube=YUOx59gwZiQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's how it can look with the Low Driven Shot PlayStyle+. The ball travels faster, the shot is more accurate, and the shot is taken more quickly.

[previewyoutube=ZhYyI9kmvXE;full][/previewyoutube]

The Low Driven Shot PlayStyle and PlayStyle+ is available in Football Ultimate Team, Career Mode (Youth Academy Players and Player Career), and Clubs.

[h3]Precision Lob Pass And Clearance Header Updates[/h3]

While TU #10 doesn't seek to redefine how the game is played, we've made a few smaller changes based on your feedback. The two most significant ones in this update are:
[list]
[*] Moderately reduced accuracy of fully powered Precision Lob Passes.
[/list]
With this change we continue towards making Precision Lob Passes behave more authentically, with the goal of lowering their use in kick off scenarios.
[list]
[*] Significantly increased the accuracy of clearance headers.
[/list]
We've seen your feedback around clearance headers, and we've increased their accuracy so that you can have more options for quickly getting the ball out of a potentially dangerous situation.

[h3]Gameplay Issues Addressed[/h3]

This update addresses a handful of smaller scale gameplay issues posted on the EASF Tracker, and we wanted to highlight two of them for you here:
[list]
[*] In some specific situations, AI defenders did not press the ball carrier as intended.
[/list]
This issue mainly occurred during potential offside scenarios, with the AI defender over prioritizing the offside line instead of attempting to press an offensive threat. To be clear, addressing this issue is not intended to improve AI defending across the board, it's to address situations where you would typically expect an AI player to press the ball carrier to begin with.
[list]
[*] Sometimes, incorrect goalkeeper save animations could have occurred when the keeper was trying to save tight angle near post shots.
[/list]
We wanted to make sure we could address this issue before introducing the Low Driven Shot PlayStyle, and now we expect the goalkeepers to behave more authentically when attempting to save tight angle near post shots.

[h2]Football Ultimate Team[/h2]

[h3]New ICONs & Heroes (Yes, The Roma Trio Is Back!)[/h3]

One of Football Ultimate Team™s most memorable trios is returning in FC 25. 

A decade after their reign, Seydou Doumbia, Victor Ibarbo, and Gervinho are back, bringing back memories of their blistering pace and silky dribbling. Starting Friday, March 14 in FUT Birthday Week 2, Streets Won't Forget versions of the Roma Trio will be available through Objectives and Evolutions in Football Ultimate Team. Additionally, FUT Birthday Hero versions of the trio will be included in the Football Ultimate Team pool of items for Packs. The Base versions of the Roma Trio will not be available in the pool of items for packs in FC 25. 

And for the first time in FC history, Franz Beckenbauer will feature in Football Ultimate Team as an ICON. Beckenbauer's career was defined by success at the highest level, winning three consecutive European Cups, two Ballon d'Or awards, and a World Cup.

On Friday, March 21, Franz Beckenbauer's Base ICON version will be added to the Football Ultimate Team pool of items for packs as part of the UEFA Dreamchasers campaign. His first campaign version will follow on Friday, April 4, debuting as part of the FUT Immortals campaign in Football Ultimate Team.

[h3]Super Sub Player Items Are Coming To Football Ultimate Team[/h3]

We're looking forward to introducing Super Sub Player Items in the near future. These Player Items will have full Chemistry when they're subbed into matches during the second half and beyond. Additionally, following the same activation conditions, Role Familiarity at the Role+ level will be increased to Role++.Just keep in mind that these Player Items need to be subbed-in in their primary or alternate positions in order for their Chemistry and Role Familiarity effects to be active.

[h3]New Live Football Ultimate Team Friendly - Targets[/h3]

We're also excited to add a new Live Ultimate Team Friendly called Targets through a Server Release soon, a match type inspired by the new Low Driven Shot PlayStyle. 
[list]
[*] At the start of the match, targets will appear at each corner of the net for both teams.
[*] Hitting those targets when scoring will count as 2 goals and will permanently destroy the target that was hit.
[*] This means each player will have an opportunity to scope up to 4 additional goals by hitting all 4 targets over the course of the match.
[*] With this new mode we aim to offer players a fun and strategic choice when deciding their shooting targets and we encourage everyone to try the new Low Driven Shot PlayStyle as an effective way to hit those lower corners.
[/list]
[h2]Clubs[/h2]

[h3]Level Cap Increase And New PlayStyle[/h3]

Following a Server Release, we'll soon be expanding Clubs progression with 20 additional levels, enabling you to earn more Skill Points and develop further.

Each level will bring 1 Skill Point, with level 120 giving 5 Skill Points for a total of 24 extra Skill Points, enabling new player progression options.

Additionally, at level 110 players will be able to unlock the new Low Driven Shot+ PlayStyle for their Avatars. Regular Low Driven Shot PlayStyle will be available without any level restrictions similar to other PlayStyles.

[h3]New Facilities[/h3]

We're introducing two new Facilities - the Low Driven Drill and Strength Drill. The Low Driven Drill Facility is a great way for everyone in the club to experience and try the new Low Driven Shot PlayStyle, and the Strength Drill will provide the Block PlayStyle+. Paired with key Attribute increases, the new facilities add more options for the club's manager.

Here's what these 3-Star Facilities will include:

Low Driven Drill
[list]
[*] Attributes: Long Pass, Shot Power
[*] PlayStyle: Low Driven Shot
[/list]
Strength Drill
[list]
[*] Attributes: Strength, Stand Tackle
[*] PlayStyle: Block+
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/acc47f635a0885f90e98c3f34c62a8bbc956f463.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/8dce2bd6591d13e4ef542f1914f5ccdc8fce1334.png[/img]

As a reminder, enhancements from Facilities apply to all player-controlled clubmates and not AI-controlled clubmates during League, Playoff, and Friendly Matches.

The new Facilities will become available following a Server Release.

[h3]Double Coin Events[/h3]

We'll be introducing Double Coins Events to Clubs following a Server Release, and players will be able to earn extra Coins during these events.

Similarly to the Double XP event introduced in First Frost update, players will be able to see 2x Multiplier in the menus to know when the event is active. We are planning to run several Double Coins and XP events over the course of the upcoming seasons, so keep an eye on Clubs menu.

notes.title: EA SPORTS FC™ 25 I Training Camp Evolutions
notes.content:
Today in Football Ultimate Team we’ll be introducing Training Camp Evolutions, a passive way to upgrade your Football Ultimate Team Player Items through the Web and Mobile Companions. Training Camp Evolutions will appear alongside other Evolutions, but they function a little differently and do not count towards the active Evolutions limit. 

When you submit an eligible Player Item for a Training Camp Evolution, that Player Item will be unavailable to use in gameplay for a set period of time until it’s upgraded, but it can still be viewed in your Club. 

When that set amount of time passes, your Evolution will have the corresponding upgrades applied once you claim it, and it can be used in gameplay once again. Some Training Camp Evolutions may even let you do further upgrades over time, enabling you to claim multiple levels of upgrades for the submitted Player Item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/3d685136c8aaa7211eacf33c5cf99b50cec0f621.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/2010886a9240473d040765211f2ed53380e6102f.png[/img]

You’ll also be able to cancel an active Training Camp Evolution if you change your mind about it, but note that this will result in your Player Item not getting any unearned upgrades, and the Evolution you had previously put a Player Item into will no longer be available. Once a Training Camp Evolution is active and until it is complete, it can only be cancelled and there is no way to temporarily pause it.

Training Camp Evolutions are intended to be a bite-sized FC experience you can interact with when you’re not actively playing FC 25 and are only available to get on Web and Mobile Companions. However, you are able to view your active Training Camp Evolution details and claim completed levels in-game on console/PC as well. You will also be able to view available Training Camp Evolutions in-game on console/PC prior to submitting an item on the Companion App.

Collecting your upgraded Player Item can be done both in-game and through the Companions, but note that claiming a completed level for your Player Item will automatically start the next level of the Evolution, if it is available.

Training Camp Evolutions will be introduced during Fantasy FC, with smaller upgrades intended to help familiarise yourself with this new system.

[h2]Frequently Asked Questions[/h2]

[h3]How can I activate a Training Camp Evolution?[/h3]
Training Camp Evolutions can only be activated on the Web and Mobile Companions within the Evolutions section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/04f1c85c9a6d4778c7beb27739fb17918e903b2f.png[/img]

Please note you are required to log out of your Football Ultimate Team on Console/PC before you are able to view your Football Ultimate Team on the Mobile or Web Companion App.

[h3]Do Training Camp Evolutions count towards my active Evo limit?[/h3]
No, Training Camp Evolutions do not count towards your active Evo limit. For example, you are able to have two active in-progress Evolutions at the same time as a Training Camp Evolution. Training Camp Evolutions have their own separate limit which is currently set at one.

[h3]How long do Training Camp Evolutions take to complete?[/h3]
Training Camp Evolutions can be as short as a few hours to longer than 30 days. The level of rewards received will generally align with the amount of time required to complete the Training Camp Evolution, so longer Evos may require more substantial time to earn.

[h3]Can I use my Training Camp Evolution in-game while it is in progress?[/h3]
No. You will be unable to use an item that is in an active Training Camp Evolution in-game until the time specified on the Evolution has passed. If you try to enter a match with a Player Item that is currently in an active Training Camp Evolution, you will receive a message prompting you to remove the Item from your Squad before you begin matchmaking.

You are able to cancel the Training Camp Evolution to return your Player Item’s in-game eligibility, however, you will not be able to receive any unearned upgrades and will not be able to restart the same Training Camp Evolution slot with another Player Item.

[h3]Are Training Camp Evolutions free?[/h3]
Similar to standard Evolutions, Training Camp Evolutions may be offered with or without in-game currency requirements. Cancelled Training Camp Evolutions will not give players the rewards from the remaining levels, and players will not receive any FC Points or Coins used on the Evolution.  

[h3]Can I start a Training Camp Evolution with an in-progress, standard Evolution?[/h3]
No, you will not be able to use in-progress Evolutions to start a Training Camp Evolution. However, you can put Items created through a standard Evolution into a Training Camp Evolution if it meets all requirements.

Thanks for checking out our Training Camp Evolutions Pitch Notes! We look forward to hearing your feedback on them. 

– The EA SPORTS FC Team

notes.title: TITLE UPDATE #9
notes.content:
The Features Update (Title Update #9) will release for EA SPORTS FC 25 in the coming days, and it’s going to address a handful of issues while enabling us to release a number of new updates in the near future, including:
[list]
[*] Increase of active Evolution slots to 2.
[*] New OVR Search Filter in Football Ultimate Team.
[*] Progress around players getting wins when Football Ultimate Team matches end early.
[*] Slightly updated Starter Packs for new Football Ultimate Team clubs.
[/list]
We saw your positive reactions to the previous Gameplay Refresh Update and want to make sure we’re maintaining a consistent gameplay experience, so we are not making any changes to the balance of the game in this update. 

We’re addressing a stability issue during throw ins, and updating our Simulation Mode slider presets to better pair offline play with some of the tuning changes from the past update. We’re continuing to review your feedback around gameplay and will make further updates based on it in the future.

[h2]Active Evolution Increase And Updated Starter Packs[/h2]

We’ve heard your feedback about wanting to do more Evolutions, and we’ll soon be increasing how many active Evolutions you can have at any given time to 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/45843efabd91fc84e110f74bd62f029113828754.png[/img]

Additionally, we’re going to be slightly updating Starter Packs for brand new Football Ultimate Team clubs following a near-future Server Release. Of course, new Clubs will still need to build towards their dream squad like before, but the updated Packs are more reflective of the current point in the season.

[h2]New OVR Search Filter In Football Ultimate Team[/h2]

We continue to update Football Ultimate Team search filters whenever we can based on your feedback, and with TU #9 we’re adding the ability to search by OVR ranges in your Club, SBCs, Rush, and Evolutions.

Here’s how the new filter looks in action:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/d30eae143cd74af175b7c6570fa744e5d6d77474.png[/img]

[h2]Updated Match Outcomes In Football Ultimate Team[/h2]

We have heard the community's frustration about not receiving a win when an opponent leaves a tied Football Ultimate Team match. 

This is a complex space, and we want to ensure fair competitive play. When we change how players get wins, draws, or losses, exploits may occur, impacting fair play, so we must be careful about how we make these changes.

With that said, we want to try to make progress here, so in an upcoming Server Release, we’ll update how some online match outcomes are determined.

Here is the change:
[list]
[*] Introduced new match outcome logic that can result in you receiving a match win when opponents quit during a tied scoreline.
[*] This change applies to solo Ultimate Team Division Rivals and Champions play, as well as Ultimate Team Division Rivals co-op play.
[/list]
There are a couple of key elements to call out about this change. 

First, this will only apply when a player uses the Quit option from the in-game Pause Menu when one of the following conditions are met:
[list]
[*] 45 or more minutes have passed.
[*] The quitting player concedes a penalty kick.
[*] The quitting player has received a red card.
[/list]
Second, there is a limit to how many times a player will be able to receive a win in this scenario. The change includes a cooldown period, and you’ll be informed in-game with a pop-up message when that limit has been reached. When released, this will be set to 5 in a 24 hour period, which resets at 00:00 GMT daily.

Our aim, as always, is to provide a safe and fun environment free from cheating. Therefore, what is listed here, including the daily limits, may change based on our analysis and/or observations that these changes are negatively impacting the player experience.

While our goal is to eventually be able to address all ways of leaving a tied match, such as a disconnect, we need to first monitor how this change is being used by players and how it’s impacting the Ultimate Team experience. 

We understand that this change will not resolve all the cases where the community has expressed frustration. However, we want to be able to make progress here, and our learnings from this initial change will help inform any further potential changes.

Thanks for checking out our Features Update Pitch Notes! And just as a reminder, the Features Update contains no changes and updates to any core gameplay systems like shooting or passing, for example.

– The EA SPORTS FC 25 Team

notes.title: TITLE UPDATE #8
notes.content:
The Gameplay Refresh Update is now available featuring the most significant mid-season gameplay overhaul we’ve ever made based on your feedback, including:

[list]
[*] Major updates to core gameplay systems like passing, shooting, goalkeeping, and defending.
[*] Addressed issues like defenders catching up to dribblers too often.
[*] More offensively fluid gameplay enabling you to move the ball easier.
[*] Reduced tacklebacks and AI interceptions.
[/list]
Let’s jump straight into the changes we’re making to EA SPORTS FC 25.

[h2]Defenders Catching Up To Fast Ball Carriers Too Easily[/h2]
Attackers controlling the ball are naturally slower than when they’re at full sprint without the ball, but we’ve seen that defenders can sometimes catch fast-moving ball carriers too quickly.

As a result, TU #8 addresses instances of players catching up to the ball carrier despite the ball carrier having much higher Pace Attributes. 

In practice, this means that it will now be harder for slower defenders to catch up to faster attackers in FC 25. Addressing this issue not only removes a pain point you’ve been telling us about, but it also helps us further focus on providing a more fluid offensive gameplay experience, as detailed throughout this Pitch Notes.

Here’s how a defender could have caught up to an attacker before TU #8.

[previewyoutube=Q4MLWnnqnbs;full][/previewyoutube]
And here’s how that same scenario can play out with TU #8, notice how the defender doesn’t catch up to the attacker easily.

[previewyoutube=c5qXDAP6mOU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]More Fluid Offensive Positioning And Better Attacking Support[/h2]

We’ve seen your feedback about the balance between how effective attacking and defending feels in EA SPORTS FC 25, so we’ve decided to make some changes to the attacking side of the game to make it more effective and fun:

[list]
[*] Improved AI teammate attacking run quality when trying to beat the offside line. AI teammates can now better hold their runs when near the line and get back onside more quickly.
[*] Increased intelligence of attacking and supporting runs made by AI teammates.
[*] Improved effectiveness of Inside and Advance Forwards.  They can move farther up the pitch. They can better evaluate when to run into space or occupy a position.
[*] Offensive players can now operate in attacking spaces near other attackers instead of stopping their runs.
[*] Players are now able to provide quicker support when they are familiar with their Role.
[/list]

To clarify that last point, this does not mean that you will see someone like a CDM all of a sudden become a striker. It means that all Roles are simply faster at performing support tasks like making themselves more open to receive a pass or making a run into space.

Overall, these changes are intended to make your team more active when you’re attacking, giving you more options while making attacks feel more fluid and organic at the same time.

For example, here’s a situation before TU #8 in which attacking AI teammates did not make any particularly effective runs.

[previewyoutube=ddpy9v6gJ6w;full][/previewyoutube]
And here’s the same situation with TU #8, showing how attacking players can now make more intelligent decisions and runs, potentially leading to a goalscoring situation.

[previewyoutube=CSi_rQ4fFAc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Reducing Tacklebacks (Losing The Ball After Your Tackle)[/h2]

Sometimes what feels like a successful tackle results in a tackleback, meaning that the opposing player wins the ball back. It happens in real life on occasion, it happens in video games too, but we’ve seen it happen more often than it should in FC 25, causing unnecessary frustration.

As a result, we’re making two changes to reduce how often tacklebacks can occur:

[list]
[*] Defenders with the Anticipate PlayStyle are now more likely to tackle the ball towards a teammate with more space if stopping the ball in place would be disadvantageous.
[*] Improved the quality of touches defenders can make on tackles.
[/list]

Here’s an example of a tackleback situation we’ve addressed. This footage is before TU #8—note how the attacker ends up winning the ball.

[previewyoutube=ft1JhYXcNnk;full][/previewyoutube]
And here’s how the same situation can play out after TU #8, note that the attacker doesn’t end up winning the ball.

[previewyoutube=Bh10ApgM6Xs;full][/previewyoutube]
In addition, we’re also addressing two issues that could have resulted in tacklebacks:

[list]
[*] In some cases, the ball carrier could have unintentionally stumbled forward when being tackled, resulting in incorrectly winning the ball back. 
[*]  In some cases, the defender could have stumbled when running towards the ball after a successful tackle rather than gaining possession.
[/list]

As usual, we’ll continue to closely look at your feedback regarding tacklebacks.

[h2]Improved Goalkeepers For Near Post Shots[/h2]

We’re looking to make goalkeepers more authentic when dealing with near post shots. To start, we’re addressing this issue:
[list]
[*] Goalkeepers could have sometimes incorrectly stepped away from the near post in tight angle shooting situations. 
[/list]
Here’s how this issue looked before TU #8.
[previewyoutube=0i_Zl6TTe5o;full][/previewyoutube]
And here’s how goalkeepers react in the same scenario with the issue addressed in TU #8:

[previewyoutube=yj4zIQjeo3w;full][/previewyoutube]
At the same time, we’re also making a more general behavior change intended to make goalkeepers more effective at covering near post shots.

[list][*] Goalkeepers will now position themselves slightly closer to the near post.[/list]

[h2]Faster Passing, Balance Changes, And Issues Addressed[/h2]

We want FC 25 to reward intelligent and quick thinking passing plays, so to that end we’re introducing the following combination of changes:

[list]
[*] Slightly increased speed of normal Ground Passes.
[*] Slightly increased accuracy of short Ground Passes to open players.
[*] Significantly increased effectiveness of Semi Assisted Through Passes. 
[/list]
While some of these changes might sound small in a vacuum, when combined with other passing changes they are designed to enable players to move the ball easier across the pitch.

Additionally, we’re tuning the effectiveness of certain passes based on your feedback and how you want the game to be played:

[list]
[*] Significantly reduced effectiveness of first-time Lofted Through Passes.
[*] Significantly increased effectiveness of Semi Assisted Through Passes.
[*] Moderately reduced accuracy of headed passes in contested situations. 
[/list]
But that’s not all when it comes to Passing, we’re also addressing a number of issues you’ve let us know about:
[list]
[*] Low powered Ground Passes were sometimes being delivered to farther players than intended.
[*] Medium powered passes sometimes focused too much on the player’s aim input instead of the amount of power generated.
[*] Addressed some instances where first time passes were less responsive than intended when the input was performed late.
[*] Sometimes, free kick passes were not hit towards the intended receiver if the receiver was moving too quickly.
[/list]
[h2]More Effective Shooting Inside The Box[/h2]

With TU #8, we want players to feel empowered with their shooting and have the ability to score more goals. So we’re introducing changes aimed at rounding out goalscoring, particularly from inside the box:

[list]
[*] Increased accuracy and shot speed from inside the box for regular and Finesse shots.
[*] Slightly increased accuracy of low difficulty regular and Finesse shots in the box.
[/list]
To clarify the second point, “low difficulty” shots refers to situations made up of many different factors, such as the shooter not being under pressure, the player’s input being accurate and well timed, the shooter having a good quality angle towards the goal like in real life, and so on.

You can think of low difficulty shots as the types of shots you would expect your favorite high skilled real world players to make.

Now, while we are generally looking to improve goalscoring from inside the box, we also wanted to adjust some tuning around Finesse shots in general. This is because we wanted to lessen the gap between players with high shooting Attributes but no Finesse Shot PlayStyle, and those with the PlayStyle or PlayStyle+. We know there has been some concern that we were planning a wholescale reduction in the Finesse Shot PlayStyle, but this is not the case:

[list]
[*] Slightly increased the impact of Attributes on the accuracy of Finesse shots taken by players without the Finesse Shot or Finesse Shot+ PlayStyles.
[/list]
We’ve also addressed the following issue:
[list]
[*] Addressed some instances where first time shots were less responsive than intended when the input was performed late.
[/list]
[h2]Defensive Positioning And Behavior[/h2]

We’re also making changes to the defensive side of the game to further encourage players to take direct control of their defensive efforts rather than relying on AI positioning.

[list]
[*] In Competitive Football Ultimate Team and Online Seasons ruleset matches, AI defenders will mark dribblers less tightly and will be less likely to cover shooting lanes near the edge of the box.
[*] Further decreased how often AI players are able to make successful interceptions.
[/list]
At the same time, we of course don’t want to neglect the defensive side of the game, so we’re looking to address a few areas based on your feedback:

[list]
[*] Defenders will focus more on man marking when defending counter attacks starting from corners. The intent of this change is to provide more effective defensive positioning against counter attacks originating from corners.
[*] RM/LM players with the Winger Balanced Role can drop deeper when defending.
[*] Falsebacks could stay central for too long when the team lost possession. They will now immediately look to return to their LB/RB positions. 
[/list]
[b]Updated Rush Club Search In Football Ultimate Team[/b]
We want to make it easier for players to search for the right Player Items when putting together their Rush Squad, and to make it easier to hit Rush Point Bonuses.

Following a near future Server Release, you’ll be able to search for Player Items simply by selecting the current Rush Point Bonus requirement. For example, if there is a minimum 75 DEF requirement, selecting that will give you 5 search results with applicable Player Items.

In cases where you don’t have 5 Player Items that meet such criteria, search results will list your top Player Items instead. For example, if you have 3 eligible Player Items, they’ll show up as search results, and the other 2 would be your top Player Items. Or if you have no eligible Player Items, you’ll just see your top 5 Player Items instead.

Of course, you can still do manual searching, and when you enter Rush squad building the default search will focus on the first Rush Point Bonus criteria.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

Made the following changes:

[list]
[*] Significantly reduced effectiveness of first-time Lofted Through Passes.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/66f64e1d4b639526fb205f766edef3b7f474b71d.png[/img] 

Weâ€™re excited to be launching Live Start Points in the coming days for EA SPORTS FC 25, enabling you to use and edit real world scenarios across Manager and Player Careers throughout the 2024/2025 season as the beginning of your journey.

We first announced Live Start Points in our Deep Dives ahead of FC 25 launch, and in this Pitch Notes weâ€™re going to cover in detail what the in-game experience will be like, so letâ€™s jump right in.

[h2]What Are Live Start Points?[/h2]

Live Start Points are a new way of experiencing Manager & Player Career, by starting your journey at access points based on real-world events across European league football throughout the 2024/2025 season.

[h2]Live Start Points[/h2] 

The following leagues will have Live Start Points available:

[list]

[*] Arkema PremiÃ¨re Ligue
[/list]
Additionally, most cup competitions will be updated to reflect real-life progress, creating more authentic scenarios for your Live Start Points. The covered competitions include domestic cups in England, Italy, Germany, and France, as well as all UEFA competitions in their current formats:

[list]
[*] UEFA Champions League
[*] UEFA Europa League
[*] UEFA Europa Conference League
[*] UEFA Women's Champions League
[/list]
Multiple Live Start Points will be available when the feature releases, reflecting the real-life progress of these leagues and corresponding to previously played gameweeks. Weâ€™ll continue to release Live Start Points throughout the 2024/2025 season.

As Live Start Points are released, be on the lookout for Snapshots in the FC 25 Main Menu, showcasing highlights of the featured European leaguesâ€™ calendar, whether itâ€™s a showstopper fixture, a derby, a title fight, or a relegation battle. Accessing Snapshots will direct you to the Live Start Points menus by simply clicking â€œTake me thereâ€. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/38c9b22a1b344fd35f593716080d6600adf29ed8.png[/img]

Otherwise, Live Start Points can be accessed when starting a new Career save, as long as youâ€™re online. Theyâ€™ll reflect the latest results and standings, enabling you to shape how the rest of the season unfolds. When creating a new Manager or Player Career from the FC 25 Main Menu, you'll see a new Live Start Points option, as shown below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/775c608b1c0d48f6e4d9dea8d0dfd72cd4b9f5d5.png[/img] 

Letâ€™s go through the Live Start Points creation experience in both Manager and Player Career.

[h2]Manager Career[/h2] 

Once youâ€™ve selected â€œLive Start Pointsâ€, youâ€™ll be able to select your club from any of the leagues listed above. At the top of your screen you'll see several dates to choose from, enabling you to pick a preferred game week as your Live Start Point. The standings, results, and upcoming fixtures will reflect that point in time, including your club's and rivals' cup progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/231f976ed774268b883fcc92762c56053360e3d4.jpg[/img] 

Itâ€™s then up to you to create your own avatar or choose playing as a real manager, similar to the usual Manager Career experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/bfe31037f6ab042d5510b6971dd49a33e0c4a58b.jpg[/img]

You have the option of viewing, removing, or editing any injuries and suspensions your squad has at that particular moment in time, meaning you can rewrite real narratives by making your players unavailable due to injury or suspension, all before you start your career. 

For example, who knows how Liverpoolâ€™s start to the season would have gone should some of their key players be unavailable? With injury and suspension editing, we want to give you more control over the types of stories that can be created in Career Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/d41273c1ca726d8311de9a6daadaac275137e34f.png[/img] 

Once youâ€™re all set up, you can advance to start your career while we load the real-life results and data. Youâ€™ll see real-world data coming in on your Career loading screen, as shown below, in the lower part of the screen.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/f87be4cf8b18bd73e46a1160ad01a4b2dbd5c227.png[/img] 

At this point youâ€™ll be prompted to create your new Live Start Points save file, and thatâ€™s it for setting up your Career Mode journey. Youâ€™re now ready to experience a football story unique to you.

[h2]Player Career[/h2] 

Similarly, when creating a New Player Career and selecting Live Start Points, youâ€™ll be prompted with a selection screen as shown below. 

Pick the team you want to play for, and choose the point in time you want to get involved.

Gameweeks are identical across both Manager and Player Careers, as are the results and standings you can start from. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/768576b5c1c0c8d80931aa5c95254cd333bbd96d.jpg[/img] 

Youâ€™ll have access to all of the usual Player Career options, from Created Player to Real Players and Icons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/cae9eb528607c3fe465011a090e10db60ac4723d.png[/img] 

Once youâ€™ve decided who you want to play as, start your career while we load up the data and set up the world. Then youâ€™ll be prompted to create your save file and can jump into the action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/05afae8121a396d2d39ea3af2757e1936546fbee.png[/img]

notes.title: Last chance: Pre-purchase EA SPORTS FC™ 25, get a Hero
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2669320/EA_SPORTS_FC_25/

Pre-purchase the EA SPORTS FC™ 25 Ultimate Edition before 20 August for Ultimate Team™ rewards in EA SPORTS FC™ 24 (sold separately) and EA SPORTS FC™ 25.*

You'll receive an untradeable Hero Player Item in EA SPORTS FC 25 Ultimate Team™ at launch with an upgraded 'Prime' version arriving in November and an untradeable Hero or ICON Player Item in EA SPORTS FC 24 Ultimate Team™ from the Greats of the Game campaign. 

[previewyoutube=yj2QH6wLQhM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]From Origin to Prime, this year’s Heroes get better with time. [/h3]

Welcome 13 new Heroes making their debut in EA SPORTS FC™ 25, each with the ability to grow with your club just as they did during their memorable careers—starting as Origin Heroes and upgrading to their Prime versions in November.

At Launch, each Hero represents the player they were at the beginning of their journey to stardom. These Origin Heroes tell the story of club favourites in the making—prospects with the potential to become great.

And in November, each Hero will ascend to their Prime. These Prime Heroes represent the player they were at the height of their powers, winning titles, setting records, and writing themselves into club history books. 

[h3]Eden Hazard[/h3]

Eden Hazard always knew his next move, eluding defenders on the pitch with his mazy dribbling and weaving his own path to greatness from Lille to London and beyond. Every change of direction had purpose, none greater than his choice to become a Blue. While at Chelsea, Hazard evolved from talented prospect to Prime Hero—and all the way to Premier League champion—carving through opponents and blazing his own trail to glory.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/6422fdf5ce484843eff4fedf219930c055b184d1.png[/img]

[h3]Tim Howard[/h3]

If the opposition didn’t score, Tim Howard probably had a hand in it. Known for stopping everything, America’s #1 would stop at nothing for greatness, challenging himself with Premier League football early in his career. He found his home in Everton blue and found his Prime in 2009, saving two penalties against his former side to lift his Toffees to an unforgettable FA Cup Final. And like any great goalkeeper, Howard never looked back—a true Hero for club and country.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/8219e115c75bca51b1949c829de74d323cdb7788.png[/img]

[h3]Laura Georges[/h3]

Always there, and everywhere. That’s the paradox of Laura Georges, a player whose travels around the world on her road transformed her into an unmovable force on the pitch. From American collegiate centre back to her Prime as Olympique Lyonnais captain and UEFA Women’s Champions League winner, Georges held everything together and held nothing back. A leader. A rock. A Hero. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/32c2e672fd17d2a5f5dea07c6e94604482eb9439.png[/img]

[h3]Maicon[/h3]

Like Rome, Milano’s Il Colosso wasn’t built in a day. Maicon’s first superpower was turning adversity into strength, a thin boy from Brazil who worked every day to grow bigger, faster, more powerful. His Italian debut—winning the Supercoppa Italiana—set the foundation for everything he was building. And in four years, a relatively unknown Maicon became a towering force in world football, leading his club to a treble as a truly colossal Prime Hero.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/813a7398ab95a62e6a3ead82fafb41ca890e2c0d.png[/img]

[h3]Guti[/h3]

Not every youth player can see a clear path to the first team. Guti could see everything. His vision on the pitch helped him rise through the ranks at Real Madrid, a homegrown talent who ended up with over 500 appearances for his boyhood club. His Prime was punctuated by pinpoint passes and trophies galore, including an iconic treble in 2011. And though it was impossible to see the game the way he did, all who saw him play saw him clearly—as a Hero.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/5e67b09d02fb00b30ebc2afe30e02bd811cce7de.png[/img]

[h3]Jaap Stam[/h3]

Feared by foes. Cheered by fans. Jaap Stam barged, duelled, and tackled his way through the leagues in the Netherlands, leaving a stream of bruised attackers and hoisted trophies and in his wake. But it was his time in England where he earned his nickname, “The Dutch Destroyer”, a man mountain in his Prime who fought his way to a treble. Stam was honoured as Europe’s best—and most feared—defender, only to go to Italy and prove it all over again.    

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/3dbaa07e071ae332f8bed38a9ed56799f99fffd7.png[/img]

[h3]Fara Williams[/h3]
Fara Williams was born to do good and destined to be great. She blazed a trail from humble beginnings to Hero status, lifting up her teammates, nation, and the entire women’s game along the way. Everton’s captain and one of England’s most beloved players, Fara led from midfield and scored for fun. Her heroics earned her several individual honours in her Prime—and even an MBE from the Queen. But what mattered to her is what she did for her people, forever a Hero deserving of her royal nickname: Queen Fara.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/75f08f9850ab2fe506b8e5e89c17c733b31c4a5e.png[/img]

[h3]Ze Roberto[/h3]

Ze Roberto was electric. A live-wire on the ball with an uncanny ability to shock his opponent, all he needed was the right stage to spark his hero’s journey. Bayer Leverkusen was that platform, a club he led in his Prime to compete at the very summit of German football—and even to a UEFA Champions League final in 2002. It was there he gained the ability to light up any match, in any league, at any level. It was there he became a Hero. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/053b8d1645816cf75c5ce7baac221215ca32dc44.png[/img]

[h3]Celia Sasic[/h3]

Celia Sasic was sensational—with a superhuman ability to sense opportunity anywhere on the pitch. Her incredible awareness and instinctive finishing turned even the slightest of chances into goals. And in her Prime, she turned those goals into golden boots, European Championships glory—twice—and UEFA Women’s Champions League greatness. Her goal in the final secured her beloved Frankfurt an unforgettable UWCL title, and scored her a place in the hearts of fans forever as a Hero. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/93a358923e98743454c7b8c27975b3424567c929.png[/img]

[h3]Marek Hamsik[/h3]

Like his iconic mohawk, Marek Hamsik’s game grew and sharpened over the years—a loyal decade in Naples where he went from “he’ll never make it” to “history maker”. At every turn, Hamsik turned difficulty into strength, disproving doubters by becoming club captain and avenging prior defeat by lifting the Italian Supercup in his Prime. “Marekiaro” arrived at Napoli as a fresh-faced prospect. He left as the club’s then-record goal-scorer, record appearance-maker, and bonafide club Hero. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/cf5303b1306329c24f47b8f9f1fcafa2bd1780f0.png[/img]

[h3]Mohammed Noor[/h3]

Control. That was Mohammed Noor’s game, and it became his superpower as developed into one of the most exciting players Asia has ever seen. First, he perfected his ability to control the ball, dribbling his way to several league titles. Then, he perfected his ability to control his opponent, moving defenders out of position with a drop of his shoulder. In his Prime, Noor’s heroics led Al Ittihad to continental glory—a Hero who truly controlled the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/424582b5e423a01df8aee75e237d28669d054afa.png[/img]

[h3]Jamie Carragher[/h3]

“We all dream of a team of Carraghers”. And at times, on Merseyside, this dream felt like a reality. Jamie Carragher was everywhere, and ever-present, for Liverpool with over 700 appearances for his boyhood club. His rise was punctuated by one of the greatest comebacks in football history, where a Prime Carragher helped the Reds erase a 3-0 deficit and lift the Champions League trophy. An unforgettable Hero, fans might still close their eyes and see Carragher’s outline on the pitch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/d42341d20a88e8c2e43fcaf6b1a0366c01b5d3fd.png[/img]

[h3]Blaise Matuidi[/h3]

Even if you could see the game like Blaise Matuidi, you’d never be able to keep up. The tireless midfielder read danger before anyone else, swooping in to stop an attack or win the ball back. A many-time league champion and World Cup champion in 2018, Matuidi would spread his arms wide in celebration after a goal, a chance for fans to see his true form—a Hero who flew around the pitch and lifted his team to titles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109432/59e4518b6cc42edd63cf6047cace39c7de3e670f.png[/img]
